VBO:0201286.summary: Climbing is a memorable habit in Manorroy’s account of Martha, a Springbatt whose litter sister Beryl is described as especially cuddly. This Springer Spaniel–Basset cross appears in the kennel’s successive generations, which it traces back to breeding begun in 2003. A 2018 owner account contrasts Honey’s long walks with Clyde’s toy-taking and frequent pauses on walks.
